name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Start in a push up position with hands under your shoulders.
Place your shins on an exercise ball, body in a straight line.
Breathe out and roll the ball toward your chest by bending your knees.
Pause, then straighten your legs to roll the ball back.

common_mistakes.fix: Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes
Move slowly and keep knees together
Keep the shoulders over the wrists
